title: felicia abyssinica var. neghelliensis
intro: Felicia abyssinica var. neghelliensis, commonly known as Neghelli daisy, is a variety of flowering plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The Neghelli daisy has been reported to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of the Neghelli daisy include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
